mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_approval_record ( business_type, business_id, approver_id, approval_result, approval_comment, approval_time, create_time, update_time, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{businessType}, #{businessId}, #{approverId}, #{approvalResult}, #{approvalComment}, #{approvalTime}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT id, business_type, business_id, approver_id, approval_result, approval_comment, approval_time, create_time, update_time, is_deleted FROM t_approval_record WHERE business_type = #{businessType} AND business_id = #{businessId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY approval_time DESC, id DESC
